name: [Full release!] Pro Piece PRO MAX
desc:
[MAXIMUM x19 FRUIT FROM FRIEND BOOST]
Welcome to Pro piece Pro Max The Remade Version of pro piece.

Start your adventure in the World with your friends for benefits!

Premium Players get +25% Reward boosts and free unlimited Stats Reset in store!

Controls : 
[W][W] / [LCtrl] - Run
[Q] - Dodge
[F] - Block
[M] - Menu
[H] - Haoshoku
[K] - Observation
[J] - Armament
Double Space - Geppo

You can drop items by using /drop in chat.

Hold Ctrl at spawned fruit to pick up

❗ Information ❗
Fruit Spawns Every 60 Minutes Under the tree and despawning after 40 Minutes.
Current Fruits in-game : Mochi, Suna, Gura , Magu, Yami, Hie, Goro , Zushi , Mera , Pika, Bomu ,Bari, Mero, Spin , Suke

Level Cap : 575

🎮 This game support PC, Mobile and Console!
 Feel free to drop some suggestions in our community!

Version : 11.11
